meta_description:
161K likes, 3,581 comments - blogilates on January 29, 2026: "I hate dupes and I never thought I’d be collecting dupes but when it came to destroying perfectly good clothing I had no choice but to save them. 

With THOUSANDS OF DUPES piled up at my warehouse (of which I have to pay extra for storage) I now had a different problem 🥲

That’s when I reached out to my friends and incredible fashion designers @transformationsbytracy and @kianabonollo to see if they wanted to help me do something cool with the dupes…and that’s how the @popflex_active Upcycle Project was born!

I am BEYOND MINDBLOWN at what Tracy and Kiana did with the fabric! Like 🤯🤯🤯 

If you sew and wanna take a stab at making these dresses yourself, go on the POPFLEX site and search for the DIY Upcycle Kits! You’ll get the digital pattern and I’ll also send you all the fabric you’ll need to complete your dress (cuz pls help me clear the warehouse!!) 

100% of all profits from your purchase will go directly to Tracy and Kiana because this project isn’t just about taking a stand against dupe culture, it’s about STANDING UP for independent designers too.

I hope to have more good legal updates for you this year! 🤞".
